flags.title: DPD Above 30 Days on Facility

flags.title: Outward Cheque Returns for Insufficient Funds
flags.evidence: The bank statements showed 2 instances of outward cheque returns for insufficient funds in October 2024 and February 2025 [S7], which triggers the hard eligibility rule requiring credit-committee approval for any outward cheque return for insufficient funds in the last 6 months [S2].

flags.title: Late GSTR-3B Filings

flags.title: High Credit Enquiries

flags.title: Increasing Debtor Days
flags.evidence: Debtor days rose from 76 days in FY2023-24 to 108 days in FY2024-25 [S16], exceeding the watch-list threshold of debtor days above 90 or increasing by more than 20 days year on year [S3].

flags.title: Stable Turnover Reconciliation
